$Comment: Rare freezing variant of Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Lightning (its hit also freezes 1.5 s). Ice lightning strike from the storm: the falling-iceberg setup (spawned on the ground, SpawnOffset Z 25 along a -90 pitch) but very fast (LaunchForce 80, about 0.3 s) with the small vanilla Ice_Bolt model. The encounter shows the 2.2 s vanilla Stalactite_Ground_Indicator first and spawns this 1.9 s later. On landing: the ice-blue AT_Ice_King_Lightning bolt, SFX_Ice_Break (a WorldSoundEventId must be mono; the thunder is stereo, so the encounter plays it), 2.3-block AOECircle on every entity. 2026-10-22 (playtest: EncLightning should look like the king's ice rays but giant; it looked like a block that suddenly fell in the red zone): Model AT_Ice_King_Ray_Giant (art: the king's zigzag ray at 6x, Light 8); VelocityDamped rotation points it down along its fall. LaunchForce 30 (was 80): 25 blocks in about 0.83 s, so the bolt is seen coming; the encounter spawns it 1.3 s after the 2.2 s warning starts (was 1.9) so it still lands as the warning fills (0.1 s Fall RunTime + 0.83 s flight). Impact visual: the vanilla Ability_Ice_Explosion (Scale 1; at 2 it whited out the player's view, 2026-10-22) added to the AT_Ice_King_Lightning bolt. 2026-10-22: on landing (ProjectileMiss) it leaves AT_Ice_King_Lightning_Stuck for 3 s. The 2.3-block hit circle stays: it matches the red ground warning, a bigger hit than the warning would be unfair.

Interactions.$Comment: 2026-10-22: wait before RemoveEntity. The Selector's HitEntity runs as forked chains on the owner (the king) with this projectile as their entity; once the projectile is gone a fork still running (DamageEntity takes 2 ticks, the freeze path ~0.2 s) is cancelled every tick but never removed (InteractionManager.doTickChain throws ChainCancelledException with the chain's own NotFinished state), so the king kept an open chain forever and every rule waiting for IsExecutingInteraction false (air attacks, orbit, phase change) froze. Found with Mob Battle's /mobbattle test chains.
2026-10-22: leave the bolt stuck in the ground for 3 s (AT_Ice_King_Lightning_Stuck), as the iceberg leaves its pillar; same SpawnNPC form and offset as Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Iceberg.
